title: Before Blaming the LLM, Diagnose the Workflow: A Role-Level Difficulty Profile for Translating Natural Language into Ontology-Grounded Statements
abstract: arXiv:2610.35267v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Natural-language-to-domain-specific-language (NL-to-DSL) semantic parsing systems increasingly translate informal user descriptions into structured artifacts such as Structured Query Language (SQL) queries, Application Programming Interface (API) calls, workflows, formal specifications, and ontology-grounded domain-specific language (DSL) statements. This paper focuses on ontology-grounded Assertion Box (ABox) DSL generation: the translation of natural language domain descriptions into assertion-level DSL statements grounded in a pre-existing ontology vocabulary. In this setting, syntactic validity is often easier to achieve than semantic adequacy. Failures are frequently attributed to weak generator models, but recurring sources of difficulty are also structural: insufficient input, weak domain grounding, output template and vocabulary gaps, weak validation, and non-local repair. translated_title: 在指责大语言模型之前，先诊断工作流：一种用于将自然语言转换为基于本体陈述的角色级难度剖析
translated_abstract: 自然语言到领域特定语言（NL-to-DSL）的语义解析系统正日益将非正式的用户描述转化为结构化产物，例如结构化查询语言（SQL）查询、应用程序编程接口（API）调用、工作流、形式化规范，以及基于本体的领域特定语言（DSL）陈述。本文聚焦于基于本体的断言盒（ABox）DSL 生成：将自然语言的领域描述翻译为锚定于既有本体词汇表的断言级 DSL 陈述。在这一设定下，句法上的有效性往往比语义上的充分性更容易实现。生成失败经常被归咎于生成器模型能力不足，但反复出现的困难根源其实也是结构性的：输入信息不充分、领域 grounding 薄弱、输出模板与词汇表存在缺口、验证机制薄弱，以及非局部性修复。我们提出了一种用于诊断……的角色级难度剖析方法（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出一种“角色级难度剖析”诊断框架，指出 NL 到基于本体的 ABox DSL 生成中的失败不应简单归咎于大语言模型，其反复出现的困难根源是工作流中的结构性问题（如输入不足、领域 grounding 薄弱、模板与词汇缺口、验证薄弱和非局部修复）。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a role-level difficulty profile for diagnosing NL-to-ontology-grounded ABox DSL generation, showing that failures should not be blamed on the LLM alone but on recurring structural sources of difficulty in the workflow, such as insufficient input, weak domain grounding, template and vocabulary gaps, weak validation, and non-local repair.
